journal: Colloids and Surfaces A: Physicochemical and Engineering Aspects
title: Large surface area sucrose-based carbons via template-assisted routes: Preparation, microstructure, and hydrogen adsorption properties
material_description: UCs-60 | sucrose-based carbon, zeolite USY hard template (zeolite : first-impregnated sucrose mass ratio 1.0), carbonized at 600 °C for 4 h under N2, template removed by HF/HCl
purification_method: excess 40% HF for 6 h, then reflux in concentrated HCl at 60 °C for 3 h (template removal); washed with distilled water; air-dried at 120 °C overnight
source_location: main p.4, Table 1, row UCs-60, hydrogen uptake column (1 bar value, in parentheses)
notes: BET range: 0.02-0.25 (p/p0, as printed). Table 1 footnotes: total pore volume from N2 adsorption at p/p0 = 0.996, micropore volume by DR equation, mesopore volume = total minus micropore. Paper names no uptake basis; gravimetric IGA with stated buoyancy correction (basis_inferred excess). H2 purity printed as 'above 99.999%'; degassing before H2 printed as 10^-7 bar (= 0.01 Pa), 200 °C, 5 h. N2 area measured on the same carbons after degassing at 300 °C for 10 h. Sample has no plotted H2 isotherm; the two printed Table 1 values (1 bar and 20 bar) are treated as one isotherm. Table 1 footnote f: value in parentheses = uptake at 77 K and 1 bar.

notes: BET range: 0.02-0.25 (p/p0, as printed). Table 1 footnotes: total pore volume from N2 adsorption at p/p0 = 0.996, micropore volume by DR equation, mesopore volume = total minus micropore.
